item.title: 【Albums (lossless)】FLAC - Whitney Houston - Brunei 1995 (Doktor's Remaster) [16/44.1 CDQ]
item.description:
Here is the legendary Whitney Houston concert in Brunei (1995), a rare private performance for the royal family where she showcased some of the most incredible vocals of her career. Regarding the technical quality, this is a genuine FLAC release, not converted files. It is important to emphasize that this audio has not been digitally limited or squashed; the volume is intentionally lower to preserve the full dynamic range of the recording, unlike other versions circulated by some people who ruin the experience by crushing the audio with compression just to make it louder.

I am sharing this specifically because there are people who refuse to share quality material with the community, so to the dismay of those gatekeepers, here is the uncompressed, dynamic audio for everyone to enjoy as it was meant to be heard. Pristine CDQ 20khz quality. Only EQ and enhancements applied. Enjoy!

Thanks for the respective collectors, George and Scott, who leaked this on internet and of course, my special thank you for "Waiting to exhale era" for the original MP3 files.

No need to answer or like, just download.
